data.body: **[P1] Prevent self-starvation through wrapped shared executors.** This synchronous submit-and-join still deadlocks when the operation and payload executors are distinct objects backed by the same bounded pool. The new identity check only rejects the exact same reference; for example, a user executor `backing` and payload executor `Executors.unconfigurableExecutorService(backing)` pass validation, then the sole worker queues payload work to itself and waits forever. Avoid blocking dispatch from user workers or guarantee isolation with SDK-owned execution, and add a wrapped one-thread pool regression test.
